Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_count number;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT product_code
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND reject_reason_code is null
 AND component_status = 'L'
 AND unit_id in (SELECT pool_id 
 FROM pooled_components
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id :='';
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id');
 clear_item; 
 show_error('1206');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) 
 INTO temp_count 
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND component_status = 'L'
 AND unit_id in (SELECT pool_id 
 FROM pooled_components
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 IF temp_count > 1 THEN
 show_error('0266') ;
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT coll_date
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 null; 
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_POOLED_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_pooled_units is
 dummy number;
 cursor c1 is SELECT unit_id, product_code prod
 FROM components
 WHERE pooled_component_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
BEGIN
 SELECT count(*)
 INTO dummy
 FROM components
 WHERE pooled_component_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;

 IF dummy <= 0 THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_no_records := 'Y';
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.unit_id');
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 go_record('1');
 FOR c1rec in c1
 LOOP
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := c1rec.unit_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.product_code := c1rec.prod;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := 
 CHK_DIGIT_QUERY (c1rec.unit_id,
 NULL,:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID);
 BEGIN
 SELECT v.product_desc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_code_desc
 FROM valid_products v
 WHERE v.product_code = substr(c1rec.prod,1,5)
 AND sysdate between eff_date AND
 nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 null;
 END;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record('1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_no_records := 'N';
 END IF;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DELETE_POOLED_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE delete_pooled_units IS
BEGIN
 /* Deleting pooled Units*/
 BEGIN 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 go_record('1');
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 UPDATE units
 SET warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND unit_id in (SELECT unit_id FROM components
 WHERE pooled_component_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code); 
 
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating Units');pause;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 UPDATE components
 SET warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 pooled_component_id = '',
 reject_reason_code = '',
 system_label_decision = '',
 expiry_date = '',
 label_user_id = null,
 label_dats = null,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.product_code; 

 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating components');pause;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF :system.last_record = 'TRUE' THEN
 exit;
 ELSE
 down;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
/* Deleting Pool Unit*/
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM pooled_components
 WHERE pool_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Pooled Components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 -- and product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 /* Delete from component_sp_reag_hdr*/
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM component_sp_reag_hdr
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Component_sp_reag table'); 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id =:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 -- and product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Component Attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM component_interdictions
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Component Interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM component_cgmp
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Component Cgmp');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM unit_add_on_bags
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in deleting from Unit Add On Bags');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 END; 
END;
